sources.title: Bank Negara Malaysia Risk Management in Technology, 25 September 2026
sources.locator: Paragraphs 2–5, 8–11; S and G clause markings

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.
Future deadlines in the September 2026 policy are not treated as already due. Appendix-specific requirements, NCII Code of Practice and permitted exclusions require separate review.
